exposure: Sonographic abdominal circumference to biparietal diameter ratio
Sonographic abdominal circumference to head circumference ratio
cohort: Women with term live-singleton deliveries during 2011-2019 and neonatal birthweight <3500 g
finding: Operative vaginal delivery, VBAC, and higher sonographic abdominal circumference ratios were independently associated with shoulder dystocia in neonates <3500 g.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal delivery was associated with shoulder dystocia in neonates <3500 g, and VBAC was also found to be associated with shoulder dystocia.
